title: Command contract v1.0 — `load --json --cwd <repo>` on a non-error outcome
description: The shape of a load answer that exited 0. What this schema checks: the result word is one of the two non-error outcomes, and the counters and budget objects the contract names are present with integer fields; the fields Memory answers beyond the contract's fixture — content, empty, degradation, identity — are typed when present and tolerated when absent, and any further additive key is tolerated. What it does not check: that the result is `ok` — whether a checkout's remote is mapped is the Memory workflow's assertion, not the shape's — and the error outcomes (integration-failed, unverifiable, prerequisite-unmet, invalid-invocation), which exit non-zero and never reach this schema.
